name: area_alerts
title: Area alerts
description: Natural disasters (GDACS), earthquakes (USGS), tsunami warnings (NOAA) and official weather warnings (Environment Canada, US NWS, MeteoAlarm for 38 European countries) for the areas you choose anywhere in the world: country, region, area. Shown on this PC; broadcast to the mesh only if you tick it. Free sources, no key. Off until you switch it on.
